model_inputs: unchanged native player-view features, card IDs, and legal action mask
comparison: 64 complete games per mode, each against seven identical scripted bots, 32 parallel lobbies with 2 episode quotas per slot
loop_scope: same episode and turn, uninterrupted sequence containing only moves and Freeze; reset on any other action
move_return: a move changes the visible board then returns to a previously seen board signature within this sequence
freeze_return: a Freeze action returns features and cards to a previously seen state within the sequence
exact_input_return: the complete native features, cards, and legal mask return to an earlier value
counts: overlapping repeated-state visits counted separately; not disjoint loop pairs
examples: up to three per type and mode; replay the stored native snapshot and actions to verify entity order or per-card frozen state exactly
limits: existing per-turn action cap 60 and default Freeze-button cap 10 are retained
changes: none to model weights, policy, reward, native legality or external project
